description: Trajectory capture: the manifest at SubagentStop and SessionStart, the catalogue at Stop and SessionEnd; why is in hooks/README.md.

hooks.command: B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event SubagentStop; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SubagentStop; fi; echo 'gray-area: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2

B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event SessionStart; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SessionStart; fi; echo 'gray-area: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2

B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event Stop; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook Stop; fi; echo 'gray-area: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2

B="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/gray-area-capture"; if [ -x "$B" ] || [ -x "$B.exe" ]; then exec "$B" -event SessionEnd; fi; F="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/fetch-bin.sh"; if [ -f "$F" ]; then exec sh "$F" hook SessionEnd; fi; echo 'gray-area: hook binaries missing — run /prosthetic-conscience:doctor --fix' >&2
